newsitem.title: USA: Franklin, Voice Powered to merge.
newsitem.headline: Franklin, Voice Powered to merge.

text.p: Franklin Electronic Publishers Inc and Voice Powered Technology International Inc Thursday said they agreed to merge.

Under the proposed merger, which is subject to certain conditions including satisfactory conclusion of due diligence, a definitive written agreement, and approval of the shareholders of Voice Powered, Franklin would pay $0.25 in cash or in shares of Franklin common stock as the parties may agree for each share of the common stock of Voice Powered Technology. The parties are targeting consummation of the merger by June 30, 1997.
Voice Powered is a producer of voice activated organizers and other products.
Franklin Electronic is the world's largest publisher of electronic books.
